notes.title: v2 Update: New Modes, Maps and Features
notes.notes:
Attention commanders!
Army War: Shooting Simulator is now more powerful, comprehensive and action-packed. With this major v2 update, radical changes have been made to the game. Brand new content that will take your combat experience to the top awaits you.

New Features and Improvements

 Mouse Sensivity setting added
 New maps and game modes added
 Bugs in the game fixed, performance improved
 Texture quality increased, graphics are now clearer and more realistic
 New languages ​​added to the game. A total of 26 languages ​​are supported.
 How to Play section added, the game became more understandable
 Automatic shooting system added after targeting enemies


A much more advanced combat environment awaits you now. Return to base as a commander and complete new missions. Now it's time to take action.
